title: Agentic Execution Class registry
description: Integrates the IBM open-stack v5 'agentic execution' model (ibm_open_stack_inventory_v5_agentic_execution_remounted.xlsx: sheets Execution_Class_Legend, Semantic_SubLayer_Map, Agentic_Execution_Model) into the estate Agent Ontology, per prophet-workspace#108 (item 4). Consume-not-fork: it does not restate the ontology — it BINDS the v5 execution classes to already-owned estate types. Each binding maps exactly one of the seven v5 execution classes to (a) a ProCybernetica ControlNode node_type — the Agent-Ontology / Fractal-Control-Fabric node the class acts as (schemas/control_node.schema.json, ADR-0002 L2, ProCybernetica#124), and (b) an AgentPassport agent_class — the host-level typed agent authorized to run it (sourceos-spec schemas/AgentPassport.json, T0-1; five-class model realized as OWL/SHACL in ontogenesis T1, ontogenesis#140). A binding MAY additionally bind one of the four v5 semantic sub-layers (Semantic_SubLayer_Map) to the estate semantic coordinate — an AgentCoordinateVector sefirotic axis (contracts/AgentCoordinateVector.v0.1.json) — as a both-or-neither semantic block. Teeth both ways are carried by tools/cybernetic_governance/validate_agentic_execution_class.py: a binding onto a valid node + a valid agent_class VERIFIES; a binding referencing an undeclared ontology node, an unknown agent_class, or a semantic sub-layer not in the map is REJECTED. Runtime execution routing per class (dispatch, gate selection, autonomy enforcement) is out of scope here and filed as follow-up @mdheller.

execution_class_binding.description: Binds one v5 execution class to the estate ontology node + agent_class it runs as. The optional semantic block binds a v5 semantic sub-layer to an estate semantic coordinate axis.

binding_id.description: Lawful identity of this binding. Unique across the registry (AEC-T6).

execution_class.description: The v5 execution class this binding types (Execution_Class_Legend). CLOSED enum of the seven classes. Tokens map to the legend prose: grounding_safe_read='Grounding + safe read tools'; tool_with_approval='Tool with approval'; tool_autonomous_safe_write='Tool with autonomous safe-write'; inter_agent_coordination='Inter-agent coordination'; policy_audit_oversight='Policy / audit oversight'; human_workflow_system='Human workflow system'; acp_client_ide='ACP client / IDE'.

control_node_type.description: The Agent-Ontology node this execution class acts as: one of the 11 ProCybernetica Fractal-Control-Fabric control-node types (schemas/control_node.schema.json, ADR-0002 L2, ProCybernetica#124). Consume-not-fork: kept in lockstep with that contract's node_type enum; the validator reconciles the two (AEC-T2) whenever control_node.schema.json is present. Referencing a token outside this closed set is rejected — 'an execution class referencing an undeclared ontology node is REJECTED'.

agent_class.description: The AgentPassport host-level typed agent authorized to run this execution class (sourceos-spec schemas/AgentPassport.json, T0-1; realized as OWL/SHACL in ontogenesis T1 / ontogenesis#140). CLOSED five-class enum, consumed verbatim. An unknown agent_class (e.g. 'anySource', which the estate never admits) is rejected (AEC-T3).

semantic_sublayer.description: Optional. One of the four v5 semantic sub-layers (Semantic_SubLayer_Map). Both-or-neither with coordinate_axis (dependentRequired). Tokens map to the map prose: glossary_ontology='Glossary / ontology'; metrics_semantics='Metrics semantics'; retrieval_semantics='Retrieval semantics'; graph_krr='Graph / KR&R'. A sub-layer not in the map is rejected (AEC-T4).

coordinate_axis.description: Optional. The estate semantic coordinate the sub-layer binds to: one of the eleven AgentCoordinateVector sefirotic axes (contracts/AgentCoordinateVector.v0.1.json). Both-or-neither with semantic_sublayer. Reconciled against that contract's coordinate set by the validator (AEC-T5).

autonomy.description: Optional free-text autonomy posture carried from the v5 Suggested Autonomy column (e.g. 'Autonomous reads; config changes gated'). Descriptive provenance only; not enforced here (runtime enforcement is the deferred follow-up).

risk_tier.description: Optional risk tier carried from the v5 Risk Tier column.

source_block.description: Optional provenance: the v5 capability plane / IBM offer this binding was derived from (Agentic_Execution_Model), e.g. 'Agent runtime & orchestration (watsonx Orchestrate)'.

rationale.description: Optional human-readable note explaining the node/agent_class/coordinate choice.
